walkthroughs.body_html:
Yield = mass ÷ area.

5 t maize from 2 ha → 5 ÷ 2 = 2.5 t/ha. Compare years or methods to see improvement.

If R > 1, cases grow; R < 1, cases fall. Vaccines lower the chance of transmission.

Herd immunity threshold ≈ 1 − 1/R. For R=4: 1 − 0.25 = 75% need immunity.

A return London–New York flight emits ~1 tonne CO₂ per passenger.

UK average is about 5 tonnes per person per year. Switching to renewables and cutting beef can reduce it.

How do decomposers return carbon to the atmosphere?
options: Decomposers release carbon by physically breaking matter into smaller pieces.
They respire — breaking down dead organic matter and releasing CO2.
Reflexes are faster because they use specially fast neurones not used elsewhere.
Decomposers turn dead matter into oxygen and water, with no carbon involved.

mcqs.q: What drives water up the xylem in a tall tree?
options: Roots actively pump water up to the leaves like a heart.
Reflexes are faster because they use specially fast neurones not used elsewhere.
Transpiration pull — evaporation from leaves creates tension that pulls water up the continuous water column.
Capillary action alone is enough to lift water to the top of any tree.

mcqs.q: Why is a reflex action faster than a conscious response?
options: Decomposers turn dead matter into oxygen and water, with no carbon involved.
The brain decides reflexes faster than other actions because it skips thinking.
Reflexes are faster because they use specially fast neurones not used elsewhere.
The signal does not need to be processed by the brain — it travels through a simpler reflex arc via the spinal cord.
